metadata.title: Privacy Policy | Porterchain
metadata.description: How Porterchain collects, uses, and protects your personal information. PIPEDA-compliant practices for Canadian customers.
metadata.ogDescription: Your privacy matters. Learn how Porterchain handles personal data across booking, merchant accounts, and delivery operations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Porterchain Inc. ("Porterchain", "we", "us") provides commercial delivery and transportation capacity services for businesses in Ontario, using proprietary software to orchestrate professional drivers, vehicles, and logistics operations. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information when you use our website, request capacity, track shipments, or interact with our support channels.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect information necessary to quote, dispatch, track, and complete deliveries, and to operate merchant and driver partner accounts.
list: Contact details: name, email, phone number, and company information
Addresses: pickup and delivery locations for routing and proof of delivery
Shipment details: weight, dimensions, photos, references, and special instructions
Payment information: billing details processed through Stripe (card data is handled by Stripe, not stored by Porterchain)
Account and compliance data: merchant onboarding documents, tax identifiers, and insurance details
Location data: GPS coordinates for driver tracking and proof of delivery
Communications: support inquiries, on-site logistics chat messages, WhatsApp messages, and email correspondence
Technical data: cookies and session identifiers from authentication and third-party services

sections.title: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use personal information to operate our logistics services, comply with legal obligations, and improve the customer experience.
list: Provide quotes, bookings, dispatch, tracking, and proof of delivery
Process payments, invoices, and merchant billing
Verify merchant accounts and maintain compliance records
Respond to support requests and operational emergencies
Send service-related notifications (booking confirmations, delivery updates, billing notices)
Improve routing, capacity planning, and platform reliability
Detect fraud, abuse, and security incidents

sections.title: Third-party service providers
paragraphs: We share information with trusted processors only as needed to deliver our services. These providers are contractually required to protect your data.

If you make a claim, or a delivery leads to an insurance claim, we share the details needed to handle it (order, proof of delivery, photos, value and contact details) with our insurance broker (Able Insurance Brokers Ltd.) and insurer (Lloyd's Underwriters) and their adjusters.
list: Keycloak — merchant and customer authentication
Stripe — payment processing
Google Maps — address autocomplete and mapping
Zoho Mail — transactional email delivery
Porterchain API — dispatch, routing, and shipment operations

sections.title: Retention and security
paragraphs: We retain personal information for as long as needed to fulfill deliveries, meet legal and tax requirements, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Shipment and billing records may be retained for several years as required by commercial and regulatory practice.

We implement administrative, technical, and operational safeguards including access controls, encrypted connections, and documented compliance procedures. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure; we continuously work to protect your information.

sections.title: Your rights (Canada)
paragraphs: Under Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and applicable provincial laws, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, subject to legal exceptions.
To exercise your rights or ask questions about this policy, contact us using the details below. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.title: Shopify delivery orders
paragraphs: When a merchant connects Shopify, Porterchain is the processor and the merchant is the controller of the buyer. We keep the buyer name, email, phone, and delivery street only to deliver the order and to answer a privacy request. We do not use that contact for marketing.

We keep that contact for 24 months after delivery, then remove the street, name, email, and phone. Postal area and the charge can remain when a tax record or a claim is still open. Shopify, Keycloak, and Stripe may process data outside Canada. The database and PorterChain dispatch stay in Canada when a stop is released.

A buyer asks the merchant. The merchant's Shopify admin sends Porterchain a privacy webhook. The merchant downloads the access file from the Porterchain privacy settings. We do not email the file to the buyer.

sections.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Privacy inquiries: driver@porterchain.com
Operations: ops@porterchain.com

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of Porterchain Inc.'s transportation capacity services, website, shipment coordination tools, APIs (where enabled), and dedicated delivery programs. By requesting a quote, booking capacity, or using our services, you agree to these Terms.

sections.title: Services
paragraphs: Porterchain provides commercial logistics services including same-day and scheduled delivery, route optimization, live tracking, and proof of delivery across the Greater Toronto Area and Ontario.
Porterchain is a structured logistics operator — not an ad-hoc driver marketplace. Services are subject to vehicle availability, operational capacity, weather, traffic, and compliance requirements.

sections.title: Bookings and quotes
paragraphs: Quotes displayed on the website are estimates based on the information you provide. Final pricing may change if shipment details, access requirements, wait times, or route conditions differ from the original quote.

You are responsible for providing accurate pickup and delivery addresses, contact information, shipment dimensions, weight, and handling instructions. Incorrect information may result in delays, additional charges, or refusal of service.

sections.title: Merchant accounts
paragraphs: Business customers may be required to complete merchant onboarding including company profile, compliance documents, and acceptance of commercial shipping terms before dashboard access is granted.

Merchant accounts are billed per billing cycle and pay by Interac e-Transfer; invoices show HST. Customers pay by card at booking, processed by Stripe. Overdue merchant accounts may be paused until payment is received.

sections.title: Prohibited goods and conduct
paragraphs: You may not use Porterchain to transport illegal goods, hazardous materials without prior written approval, items that violate carrier insurance terms, or shipments that endanger drivers or the public. We do not carry firearms or weapons, cash or securities, cannabis, human or animal remains, live animals, live plants or cut flowers, or tobacco or alcohol across provincial borders. Cash, jewellery, medicines and perishables can travel but can't be covered by declared-value cover. Target commodities (alcohol, tobacco and vaping products, electronics, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and fragrances) are accepted with a $25,000 limit per shipment; tell us before booking if a load is worth more.
We reserve the right to refuse, hold, or return any shipment that violates these Terms or applicable law.

sections.title: Liability and claims
paragraphs: Our liability for loss or damage is limited to $4.41 per kg of the goods affected (Ontario Uniform Conditions of Carriage, O. Reg. 643/05), unless declared-value cover was bought at booking. Optional declared-value cover, where offered at booking, costs 1.5% of the declared value ($3 minimum) and covers up to $2,500 per parcel; cash, jewellery, medicines and perishables can't be covered, and proof of value (invoice or receipt) is required to claim. In every case the most we pay for one shipment is $50,000, or $25,000 if the shipment contains target commodities (alcohol, tobacco and vaping products, electronics, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and fragrances). We are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss caused by an act of God, war, the shipper's fault, or the inherent nature or defective packing of the goods, except where the law says otherwise. Coverage is subject to these terms and your merchant agreement.

Please report loss or damage to ops@porterchain.com as soon as you can, ideally within 5 business days of delivery, with the order number, photos, proof of value and a description. Written notice must reach us no later than 60 days after delivery, or 9 months after shipment if the goods were never delivered, as the Ontario Uniform Conditions of Carriage require. Keep the goods and packaging for inspection. We reply within one business day and aim to decide within 30 days of receiving a complete claim. PorterChain carries commercial general liability insurance ($2,000,000 per occurrence) and motor truck cargo insurance with Lloyd's Underwriters; a certificate of insurance is available to merchants on request.

sections.title: Cancellations and refunds
paragraphs: Cancellations before dispatch may be eligible for a full or partial refund depending on timing and operational costs incurred. Cancellations after a driver is dispatched may incur fees.
Retail payments processed through Stripe on the tracking page are subject to the refund policies communicated at checkout.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada applicable therein. Disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Ontario, unless otherwise agreed in a merchant agreement.
Questions about these Terms: driver@porterchain.com · +1 (647) 619-7951

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Porterchain Inc. uses cookies and similar technologies on porterchain.com and related web applications. It should be read together with our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help sites remember preferences, keep you signed in, and understand how services are used.

sections.title: Cookies we use
paragraphs: Porterchain and our integrated partners may set the following types of cookies:
list: Essential cookies — required for site functionality, security, and session management (always on)
Analytics cookies — load only if you allow Analytics in the cookie banner (Consent Mode)
Marketing cookies — ads/remarketing pixels only if you allow Marketing and the related env IDs are configured
Experience cookies — optional Clarity/Hotjar only if you allow Experience
Authentication cookies — set by Keycloak when you sign in or verify your account
Preference cookies — such as language selection (English / French) and your cookie banner choices
Payment cookies — set by Stripe during checkout on tracking and billing pages
Maps cookies — set by Google Maps when using address autocomplete or map features

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: The following third-party services may load scripts or set cookies when you use our website:
list: Keycloak — authentication for retail booking, merchant portal, admin, and driver portals
Stripe (stripe.com) — payment processing

sections.title: Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential or authentication cookies may prevent you from booking deliveries, signing in, or completing payments.
On-site logistics chat runs on PorterChain infrastructure. On phones you may also open WhatsApp. You can always contact us by email or phone instead.

sections.title: Updates and contact
paragraphs: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the most recent revision.
Questions: driver@porterchain.com · ops@porterchain.com · +1 (647) 619-7951
